correctness.rationale: The maps and persistence structure are defined explicitly. The homology distance is zero because the sole transition map is an isomorphism between integral homology spheres. The length-\(m\) interleaving is explicit; every shorter interleaving would force a degree \(\pm1\) map \(S^3	o\Sigma\), contradicting the degree-120 universal cover. Every lower-set fiber has contractible target after shift \(2\lceil m/2ceil\), with a compatible point section, so the stated fiber hypothesis holds.
